title: Japan's top five chip equipment makers posted their first-ever fall in combined China sales, down 10% in the year ended March 31, as China boosts local players (Nikkei Asia)
summary: Nikkei Asia: Japan's top five chip equipment makers posted their first-ever fall in combined China sales, down 10% in the year ended March 31, as China boosts local players — TOKYO — Japan's top five manufacturers of chipmaking equipment posted a 10% decline in combined sales to China for the year ended March 31 …
